business_problem: Weiyi Manufacturing needed to reduce reliance on exhausting manual visual inspection in 3C factories because workers had to inspect thousands of parts from many angles every day, which caused fatigue, unstable quality, and persistent miss-detection issues with both human and traditional rule-based vision systems.
solution_summary: Weiyi Manufacturing and Baidu AI Cloud built an AI visual-inspection system for complex surface defects in 3C production. The solution combines Baidu's industrial quality-inspection capabilities with cloud infrastructure so line images can be captured, processed, classified, and shared digitally instead of relying on purely manual judgment. The inspection device can capture 18 to 24 images in about one second and uses a Baidu algorithm engine to process up to 24 models, classify more than 34 defect types, and complete the full decision pipeline in 480 milliseconds. Beyond detection, the system uploads inspection statistics such as daily output and defect information to the cloud for SPC-style analysis and digital sharing. The result is a full-angle visual-quality workflow that covers six product faces, identifies defect size, location, and shape automatically, and lets operators shift from repetitive visual screening to higher-value defect analysis and annotation work.

solution_components.name: Intelligent Industrial Quality Inspection Solution
solution_components.role: Provides the end-to-end visual inspection workflow for defect detection, classification, and quality control.

solution_components.name: BCC
solution_components.role: Hosts the cloud infrastructure used to upload inspection results for analysis and digital sharing.

solution_components.name: Baidu Algorithm Engine
solution_components.role: Runs the deep-learning defect models that detect and classify surface problems at high speed.

data_flow: Production-line images are captured from multiple angles, processed by the algorithm engine to detect and classify defects, and then uploaded with output and defect statistics to cloud services for SPC-style analysis, reporting, and digital sharing back to factory operations.
business_outcome: Weiyi improved inspection accuracy and speed, reduced quality-rework risk, and moved frontline workers from repetitive visual checking into more valuable analysis and labeling roles.
